text:
Maya: quick check — for automatic fallback alerts, do we show a firehose of raw events or a distilled operator view by default? thinking about oncall fatigue.
Ravi: distilled view. show actionable items only. we can provide a link to raw trace for forensic.
Noor: +1 but surface config-change windows and canaries as 100% captured. auditors ask for full fidelity during those windows.
Lin: UX suggestion: single list with severity chips (P0/P1/P2) and an "expand" chevron that reveals the trace link + redaction notice.
Sam: minimal indexed schema proposal — index the fields you'll search on and store a trace pointer. example: ```json
{
  "decision_id": "dec-1765555555-1",
  "severity": "P1",
  "summary_tag": "5xx_burst",
  "route": "/v1/chat/completions",
  "policy_id": "autofallback-v2",
  "trace_obj": "s3://org-retentions/trace/dec-1765555555-1.json"
}
```
Maya: agree indexing only. full traces go to cold storage with ACLs and redaction pipeline.
Ravi: sampling rules idea: 
- critical: 100%
- elevated: 25%
- standard: 1%
- always keep 1/min baseline per route
This balances cost and signal.
Noor: can we let customers opt into higher retention per tenant? enterprise will pay for it. tenancy controls need to exist.
Lin: yes, but keep org-level caps to avoid runaway egress. expose a billing alert if tenant retention > X/day.
Sam: API surfaces: /inbox?route=&severity=&cursor=, decision object includes severity, summary_tag, decision_id, trace_url, policy_id, model_commit. Playback endpoint must verify ACL and return redacted payloads.
Maya: security: redact user prompts by default unless SRE explicitly requests with reason and 2FA. log the requester.
Ravi: compliance: add export_for_audit action that atomically takes a snapshot for a window and drops NDJSON to an org S3 path with WORM retention.
Noor: replayability note: include input_hash, model_version, tokenizer_profile so replays are deterministic for root-cause analysis.
Lin: small UI thing: sparkline for fallback rate + a tiny counter of suppressed events so ops know volume.
Sam: implementation Q: sampling config mutable per-tenant via console or infra-only flag?
Maya: console toggle for enterprise tiers, infra-only for org defaults. changes must be auditable.
Ravi: operator actions: mute-route (temp), pin-event (for postmortem), export-selection, escalate-to-sre. each action writes an immutable audit log entry.
Noor: agree. also require mandatory reason for mute longer than 5m.
Lin: prototype plan: Jess (UX) to mock compact inbox card, Sam to draft API and sampling config, Ravi to draft retention/billing guardrails. deploy a staging proto.
DeployBot: deployment queued: feature/autofallback-inbox -> staging (build 2026.05.01.2).
Maya: sounds good. let's limit canary to 3 tenants and watch operator inbox load and storage delta for 48h.
Sam: I'll open the PR with schema + example payloads now. tagging @Noor @Ravi for review.
Noor: will add compliance checklist to PR.
Maya: thanks everyone — aim to sync tomorrow after initial staging metrics. :rocket:
